sentences.japanese: 一週間でどれほどのことが学べるか、自分でもびっくりするはずだよ！
sentences.english: You'd be surprised what you can learn in a week.

sentences.japanese: 僕は彼女無しに生きる術を学んだ。
sentences.english: I learned to live without her.

sentences.english: At the age of six he had learned to use the typewriter and told the teacher that he did not need to learn to write by hand.

sentences.japanese: 決して学ぶのに遅すぎるということはない。
sentences.english: It is never too late to learn.
